headline: Last session: Sensex surged 1,718 points to 81,028 while Nifty reclaimed 25,000 in strong rally

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Sunday, 8 November.

why: Sensex surged 1,718 points to close at 81,028 during the last trading session.
Nifty 50 reclaimed the key 25,000 level to end Samvat 2082 on a strong note.
Indian stock markets bucked global tech selloffs to record their best weekly performance in 6 years.
Financial and auto stocks led the robust market rally across recent sessions.
whatHappening: Amber Enterprises' arm IL JIN Electronics filed a DRHP with SEBI to raise Rs 2,500 crore via IPO.
Prestige Group acquired a 100% stake in Allure Developers for Rs 524 crore for a housing project in Noida.
Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings filed DRHP with SEBI to raise funds through an initial public offering.
Karnataka claimed ethanol blending levels reached 31% against the target E20 petrol standard.
summary: On the last trading day, Indian benchmark indices surged sharply with the Sensex jumping 1,718 points and Nifty reclaiming the 25,000 mark. Indian stocks bucked broader global market tech selloffs to log their best weekly performance in six years. Corporate actions were highlighted by Prestige Group acquiring Allure Developers and IPO DRHP filings from Amber Enterprises' subsidiary.
